def answer_query(image):
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    woman_patches = image_patch.find("woman")
    white_shirt_patches = image_patch.find("white shirt")

    # Filter patches that have both "woman" and "white shirt"
    valid_patches = [patch for patch in woman_patches if patch in white_shirt_patches]

    # Sort patches by their distance to the center of the image
    center_x = image_patch.right - image_patch.left
    center_y = image_patch.upper - image_patch.lower
    valid_patches.sort(key=lambda patch: math.sqrt((patch.left + patch.right - 2*center_x)**2 + (patch.upper + patch.lower - 2*center_y)**2))

    # Return the patch closest to the center that has "back to us"
    for patch in valid_patches:
        if patch.simple_query("Is the person facing us or facing away?") == "facing us":
            return patch

    # If no patch fulfills the condition, return the patch closest to the center
    return valid_patches[0]
